sources.entry: seleniumbase - Python framework for web automation & testing, with stealth options.

summary.one_liner: SeleniumBase is a Python framework for browser automation, web scraping, and end-to-end testing, with stealth features for getting past bot detection and CAPTCHAs.
summary.what_it_does: It wraps Selenium/WebDriver with higher-level methods such as type, click, assert_element, and goto, where each call waits for elements to be visible and interactive before acting. It runs tests through pytest, pynose, or behave, or as plain Python scripts using an SB context manager or a Driver object. Its CDP Mode (sb_cdp) drives Chromium through the Chrome DevTools Protocol and is described as bypassing BrowserScan, Sannysoft, and Cloudflare Turnstile checks in the README examples. A solve_captcha() method handles CAPTCHAs that are not bypassed automatically. The README also covers a dashboard and HTML/JUnit/Allure reports, a test recorder, proxy and user-agent options, and automatic chromedriver downloads.
use_cases: web scraping sites with bot protection
bypassing Cloudflare or CAPTCHA challenges in automation
generating test reports and dashboards for test runs
recording browser actions into test code
notable: CDP Mode (sb_cdp) for stealth browser automation without WebDriver, plus stealthy Playwright examples
solve_captcha() method for CAPTCHAs not bypassed automatically
Smart waits: methods wait for elements to be ready, and assert_* methods wait up to 7 seconds
Built-in SeleniumBase Dashboard, HTML/JUnit/Allure reports, and a Recorder that generates test code
CLI switches for Chrome, Chromium, Chrome-for-Testing, Edge, Brave, and Firefox, with a proxy option
caveats: Stealth and CAPTCHA bypass results are shown only as examples in the README and are not guaranteed against all anti-bot services.
Full CLI option list is extensive and some options (e.g., Allure) require separate installs; allure-pytest is not installed by default.
README says Chromium-based browsers get most support; Firefox and Safari are only listed as supported browsers, and some options like proxy auth are Chromium only.
